crossRefs.note: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

translations.web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
translations.bsb: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
translations.kjv: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
